findings.text: asserts the profile URI with SLURM_JOB_ID cleared but NEO4J_URI left ambient, so the env read this node added makes the test fail on correct code: with NEO4J_URI=bolt://example.invalid:1 exported the assertion is AssertionError: assert 'bolt://example.invalid:1' == 'bolt://localhost:17687' (2 failed, 7 passed for the file).

factory() is invoked with the ambient environment, so the same exported NEO4J_URI makes the default-factory pin fail — AssertionError: assert 'bolt://example.invalid:1' == 'bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687' — so the test that exists to pin this repair reports red on any machine or CI that uses the documented escape hatch.

justifications.durability: All four defects are pinned and the pins fire. Three independent reversions in a copied scratch tree each fail exactly one named test: the factory reverted to get_graph_uri fails only test_the_client_default_uri_is_the_slurm_aware_resolver (message names the reverted factory, which is also the load control), removing the explicit-URI early return fails only test_explicit_neo4j_uri_wins_inside_a_slurm_step (assert 'bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687' == 'bolt://example.invalid:1'), and restoring the bare except fails only test_an_unreadable_location_is_not_swallowed (Failed: DID NOT RAISE RuntimeError). The file passes 9/9 at the reviewed commit. The focused gate is tests/graph under default markers: at head it searches the whole directory (4 failed, 517 passed, 355 deselected) and at the base revision 4c4f48c4c the base tree is reconstructed from git archive and re-runs the three files those failures live in (4 failed, 15 passed); the two failure-id sets are identical (test_repository_cypher_literals_have_declared_properties, test_auto_sync_skips_when_in_sync, and two test_updated_at_coverage ids), so the head's four are pre-existing and outside this node and the added-failure count is zero. The base run confirms the ids rather than searching for them, which is the direction the delta claim needs. Docked: the resolution now reads os.environ['NEO4J_URI'] directly and two tests assume that variable is unset in the ambient environment, so an operator or CI using the documented escape hatch sees a red suite on correct code, and the failures land on the tests that pin this repair.
justifications.evidence: Every claim in docs/evidence/sn-release-readiness/graph-client-slurm-resolution.md was opened against its log and matches: unit_before.log carries the 2 failed that reproduce the precedence loss and the swallow, unit_final.log the 9 passed, revert_run.log the 1 failed, 8 passed naming get_graph_uri, step_repaired.log and step_explicit_uri.log the job-1273665 readings inside a real step where the client resolves bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687 with count(StandardName) 5130 and the explicit URI beats the still-resolvable gpu address (the discovery line is the control), and login_node.log the unchanged reading. sacct corroborates jobs 1273478 and 1273665 as COMPLETED on 98dci4-clu-3141. The scratch reversion was reproduced here independently in a copied tree rather than a hard-linked one, with the scratch module's identity shown before the runs.
justifications.fit: The change follows the module's own idiom: function-local imports, mechanism-named helpers, and docstrings that state the rule (the env var outranks profile and discovery; an unreadable location raises) rather than an incident; no plan, sprint or ticket label appears in the source, both commit messages carry bodies, and ruff check is clean on both changed Python files. Docked for the same environment coupling: the newly added env read shipped without an env-isolated test, which is what monkeypatch.delenv('NEO4J_URI', raising=False) is for, and the failure text then names the repair rather than the real cause. Noted rather than docked: the early return reads the environment directly instead of through get_graph_uri(), which is justified in the docstring because the accessor would run the profile and discovery work the escape hatch exists to outrank.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's goal — pin the SLURM address repair with a test that fails without it, and restore the documented NEO4J_URI precedence — holds under independent measurement. Reverting field(default_factory=_resolve_graph_uri) to get_graph_uri fails exactly the factory test, and the failure text names the reverted symbol; removing the explicit-URI early return fails exactly the precedence test with assert 'bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687' == 'bolt://example.invalid:1'. The whole file passes 9/9 at the reviewed revision in this reviewer's own worktree, and a live login-node GraphClient() built from the reviewed code resolves bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687 and answers count(StandardName) 5130, so the repair is intact and its precedence is the documented one. The two further defects the node closed (the swallowed location read, the inert monkeypatch) are each pinned by their own test.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 4c4f48c4cf23bf49fb0a7ad33848fcd964576e86 c2c66ad7506046021284d13ffa52aaeb69743bab is 5 files, exactly the node's declared write paths: imas_codex/graph/client.py, tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py, docs/evidence/sn-release-readiness/graph-client-slurm-resolution.md, docs/plans/sn-release-readiness.html and docs/evidence/archive/sn-release-readiness-landed.html. The plan edit adds only the landing-record comment and touches no meta line; both commits are conventional with bodies and carry no AI attribution.
